out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed the hot water at the front hand sink at 76F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back of the kitchen is blocked by an old frozen yogurt machine preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. EMPLOYEE WAS OBSERVED WITH ONLY SOME OF HER HAIR PULLED BACK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EMPLOYEE PULLED HER HAIR BACK AND PUT ON A VISOR.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back of the kitchen is blocked by an unplugged yogurt machine, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED YOGURT MACHINE.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the back of the kitchen being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hit water at the handwashing sink in the front of the kitchen was observed at 85F and the handwashing sink in the back of the kitchen was observed at 88F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC ADJUSTED HAND SINK HOT WATER TO 100F AT BOTH HAND SINKS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed frozen yogurt mix thawing in the 3 compartment sink in standing water
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EMPLOYEE PLACED YOGURT MIX IN THE REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC PURCHASED A FOOD THERMOMETER.
